survey.scope: Observed 24,584 filesystem members: 3,152 repository artifacts and 21,432 additional local archive, test, build and reference members. concerns.finding: The project tool and page use the project graph store, while legacy CLI, memory and dispatch paths still use a separate SQLite map, so reads and tickets can disagree across surfaces.
The intended specification-block overlay, atomic document round trip and localized specification delivery are absent from the current Python project engine.
The store refused a five-record subtype edit and subsequent map read with buffer-pool exhaustion. Restart restored access, and individual edits then succeeded.
concerns.evidence: Project tool response: INTERNAL_ERROR, Buffer manager exception: Unable to allocate memory! The buffer pool is full and no memory could be freed!; src/metaform/project/store.py:80

concerns.description: Functional drift and apparent faults encountered during Digital Typology intake.
concerns.instruction: Record an evidenced concern at its functional owner. Identify missing functionality, a broken behavior, or material excluded pending examination. Do not repair it as part of intake.

finding.rule: A concise statement of the function affected and the observed discrepancy.
finding.example: Command surfaces read a different map from the project tool.

evidence.rule: The source URI and exact location supporting the observation.

memories.description: What is worth keeping about this element: each record is one observation of a named entity.
memories.instruction: Add one record for each fact, one fact in one sentence. Records that share an entity are that entity's observations.

entity.rule: The name of what the fact is about.

entity_type.rule: What kind of thing the entity is.

observation.example: watch loads the timers when it starts, so one started later is not rung by it.

subtypes.description: Purpose refinements within a native wants join. Each record belongs to the holder's want identified by element and parent_ref. Absorbed functions retain the parent provider's namespace identity.
subtypes.instruction: Record one absorbed function at a time. Match element and parent_ref to an existing want held here. Keep its own purpose, encounter, flow and evidence. Do not create a separate namespace element for an absorbed function.

element.rule: The namespace address of the provider in the parent purpose join.

parent_ref.rule: The ref of the matching native wants join held by this receiver.

why.rule: The receiver's active purpose as a bare infinitive phrase.

how.rule: The provider's encounter as a third-person present verb phrase.
how.example: stores each element at its functional namespace address

direction.rule: The substantial flow that satisfies the receiver's purpose.

status.rule: Use unbuilt only for an intended absorbed function absent from the current implementation.

survey.description: The bounded artifact survey and final proof of this functional map.
survey.instruction: Keep observed scope and proof concise. A count describes this intake, and the evidence URI preserves its observation record.

scope.rule: What was observed and how it bounds the map.
scope.example: Observed all repository members outside the excluded paths.

members.rule: The number of observed repository members.

status.rule: Whether the survey and closure proof are complete.

tickets.description: Work assigned at this element: each record is one ticket, from asked to done.
tickets.instruction: Add one record for each piece of work. Change one by its position with update: taken_by when an agent takes it, note to say where it stands, done and outcome when it ends. On the board a ticket is done once done is set, doing once taken, in the backlog while held, and to do otherwise.

id.rule: A short id that stays the same for the ticket's life.

title.rule: One line that names the work.

task.rule: What to do, in full, for an agent that knows nothing else of it.
task.example: Make watch ring each timer as it ends, also one started while watch runs.

kind.rule: What kind of work it is; left out for a plain task.

held.rule: True while it waits in the backlog and is not to be started.

taken_by.rule: Who took it, once someone has.

note.rule: Where it stands now, by whoever last worked on it.
note.example: watch now reads the timers again before each sleep.

done.rule: When it ended, as a date and time; left out while it is open.

wants.description: A list of want records. A record holds element (the wanted element's address), why, how, direction (send, receive or both) and ref (the uri of the one artifact the want is about). An element may hold several wants on the same element, one for each artifact or purpose. The wanted element is created at its own address if it is not there.
wants.instruction:
why and how are sentence fragments that complete the sentence below.
{this.address} ({this.name}) requires {other.address} ({other.name}) in order to {why}, which {how}.

why.rule: Bare infinitive verb phrase. State the active goal as a sentence fragment beginning with a base action verb. Do not include a leading 'to', subject nouns, or any words ending in -ing.
why.example: drain raw frames from the network interface card

how.rule: Third-person singular present indicative verb phrase. State how the provider satisfies the goal beginning with a present-tense verb ending in -s or -es that agrees with 'which'. Do not include subject nouns, 'by', or any words ending in -ing.
how.example: holds descriptor pointers across contiguous memory segments

ref.rule: The uri of the one artifact the want is about.

checks: All recorded elements and purpose records read back from the project tool.
All providers resolve to recorded namespace addresses.
All subtype purposes nest beneath the matching receiver-owned want.
All local entry points and evidence refs resolve.
All functionality is reachable from the vested beneficiaries through one defining element.
No absorbed subfunction remains as an independent namespace element.
proof.limits: Source and artifact inspection establishes functional relationships. This intake did not run product tests or repair recorded concerns.
